title: A delegation's max_result_chars sets how much of the worker's output its relayed result carries: an output past it is cut to it and marked truncated, one exactly at it is handed back whole, and a bound above the default lets more through

content.body:
[Background task from worker completed. Task: “big task”. Share the outcome with the user.]

[...truncated]
</worker_output>
